titulo_fr: Un avis de santé : Observer les formes
titulo_es: A health notice: Vocabulary and forms
intro: Read brief instructions for a consultation without confusing symptoms, time and place. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Read brief instructions for a consultation without confusing symptoms, time and place. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention: The instructions use the imperative; a frequency like « deux fois par jour » accompanies the action. In this fragment, «rendez-vous» means «date».

frases.fr: Pour prendre rendez-vous, appelez le numéro indiqué sur la porte.
frases.es: Para pedir cita, llame al número indicado en la puerta.
frases.en: To order an appointment, call the number at the door.

frases.fr: La salle d'attente se trouve au premier étage, à droite.
frases.es: La sala de espera está en el primer piso, a la derecha.
frases.en: The waiting room is on the first floor, on the right.
